title: 第9章 得胜回家第10章 调整修炼方向
content_zh:
第9章得胜回家
在战斗结束后，族长刘百山立即带领族人忙着打扫战场，收缴战利品。
家族庶务堂的族人则忙着记录参与战斗的族人功勋，核算族人应得的家族贡献点。
赏罚公平公正，是保证一个家族凝聚力和战斗力，实现长盛不衰的重要一环。
这方面的教训，是无数家族和宗门用血的教训换来的。很多强盛一时的家族和宗门就是内部赏罚不公，人心涣散，从而走向衰落和灭亡。
一切工作完毕后，爷爷刘百山带领家族众人返回了桃山。
当众人回到桃山时，留守家族的大长老刘秋生，带领留守桃山族人为得胜归来的族人举行仪式了热烈的欢迎，一时间桃山上处处都是欢快的笑声。
回到桃山后，族长刘百山立即组织召开了长老会。
在会议上，刘百山首先说道：“今日我们取得了一项非常重要的胜利，我们将流窜到家族领地的青风狼群消灭了。但是也给我提了一个醒，如果再有更加强大的狼群前来我们该怎么办！”
听到刘百山的话，在坐的长老们都陷入沉思。
四长老刘百川第一个打破了沉默，说道:“家族周边的形势确实让人担忧。幸好这次天佑我刘家，如果狼群的规模再大些，或者狼群中有一只二阶妖兽，对我刘家来说就是灭顶之灾。我们不能总是寄希望好运气吧！所以，我认为家族应该尽全力培养出一名筑基修士”。
刘百山说道:“是啊！家族不能每次都要靠好运气。但是，目前家族适合筑基的人选一个没有啊！”
一般来说，适合筑基的修士，除了在修为上达到炼气大圆满外，年龄不能超过60岁。
修士年龄一旦超过60岁，因身体气血衰败，筑基成功的可能性几乎为零。
大长老刘秋生这时说道:“目前家族修士中，年龄在60岁以下的，修为最高的是世盛和世昊。大家看这样行不，这两个人，谁第一个修炼到炼气大圆满，家族就先支持他筑基。”
听到刘秋生的建议后，各位长老均表示同意。
特别是父亲刘世昊和刘世盛，两人都纷纷在心中较劲。
族长刘百山接着说道:“现在两人距离修炼到炼气大圆满还有一段时间。因此，除了加快培养家族筑基修士，大家都说说，还有什么好办法能够短期内提高家族实力？”
刘百川说道:“今天看到长旭的战斗给了我一定启发。我觉得家族修士在对敌战斗中缺少配合，以后应加强家族修士在战斗力的配合。”
族长刘百山听到刘百川夸奖自己的孙子非常高兴，笑着说道:“我看百川的意见很好，狼群的战斗力之所以强大，就是由于狼群在战斗中分工明确，配合得当，我们也要向狼群学习，至少有一些基本的配合。这件事就由百川负责吧！”

刘百山又接着说道：“我们家族的机构设置和长老分工也需要完善，大家都讨论一下吧！”
对这个涉及到切身利益的话题，众长老的发言就活跃了很多。各长老你一言我一语，整整讨论半天，才将机构设置和长老分工讨论完毕。
会议做出了如下决议：
家族族长负责管理家族日常事务，族长由家族长老会推选产生。
家族长老是家族长老会成员。家族长老会是家族最高议事机构。
家族修士修为进入炼气后期，且无严重违反族规行为，经族长和长老会确认，即可成为家族长老。
现在家族共有八名长老，分别是:
大长老刘秋生，秋字辈老十六，炼气大圆满。
二长老刘秋水，秋字辈老十七、炼气大圆满修为。
三长老刘百河，百字辈老二，炼气大圆满修为。
四长老刘百川，百字辈老七，九层修为。
五长老刘百强，百字辈老十二，炼气九层修为。
六长老刘世盛，世字辈老四，炼气八层修为。
七长老刘世昊，世字辈老五，炼气九层修为。
八长老林玉莲，炼气七层修为。
具体家族事务的管理由八个堂口负责:
一是庶务堂，负责家族任务发布，记录功勋，管理族库。堂主是大长老刘秋生。
二是传道堂，负责对家族子弟的培养，管理传道院及藏经阁。堂主是二长老刘秋水。
三是族兵堂，负责组织族兵对外战斗，管理家族猎妖队。堂主是四长老刘百川。
四是灵植堂，负责组织家族灵植师，种植灵药、灵果、灵米、灵木等。管理家族灵果园、灵药园、灵田。堂主是七长老刘世昊。

五是炼丹堂，负责家族炼丹师的培养、考核。组织家族炼丹师，为家族炼制丹药。堂主是三长老刘百河。
六是符阵堂，负责家族符箓师和阵法师的培养，考核。负责组织家族符箓师和阵法师，为家族制作符箓、阵法。堂主是五长老刘百强。
七是炼器堂，负责家族炼器师的培养，考核。组织家族炼器师为家族炼制法器。堂主是六长老刘世盛。
八是商贸堂，负责家族对外贸易，负责家族商队及在外店铺的管理运营。堂主是八长老林玉莲。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 9 Victory and Returning Home
After the battle, the clan leader Liu Baishan immediately led his clan members to clean up the battlefield and collect the spoils of war.
The clansmen in the family general affairs hall were busy recording the merits of the clansmen who participated in the battle and calculating the family contribution points that the clansmen deserved.
Fair rewards and punishments are an important part of ensuring a family's cohesion and combat effectiveness, and achieving long-term prosperity.
The lessons in this area were gained through bloody lessons from countless families and sects. Many families and sects that were once powerful suffered from unfair internal rewards and punishments, and lost people's hearts, leading to decline and destruction.
After all the work was completed, grandfather Liu Baishan led the family back to Taoshan.
When everyone returned to Taoshan, Liu Qiusheng, the eldest elder of the left-behind family, led the left-behind Taoshan tribe to hold a ceremony to warmly welcome the returning tribesmen. For a time, there was cheerful laughter everywhere on Taoshan.
After returning to Taoshan, the patriarch Liu Baishan immediately organized an elders' meeting.
At the meeting, Liu Baishan first said: "Today we achieved a very important victory. We eliminated the Qingfeng wolves that fled to the family territory. But it also reminded me of what we should do if there are more powerful wolves coming!"
After hearing Liu Baishan's words, the elders sitting there all fell into deep thought.
Fourth Elder Liu Baichuan was the first to break the silence and said: "The situation around the family is indeed worrying. Fortunately, God has blessed my Liu family this time. If the size of the wolf pack is larger, or there is a second-level monster in the wolf pack, it will be a disaster for my Liu family. We can't always hope for good luck! Therefore, I think the family should do its best to cultivate a foundation-building monk."
Liu Baishan said: "Yes! The family cannot rely on good luck every time. However, currently there is no suitable candidate for foundation building in the family!"
Generally speaking, monks suitable for foundation building must not exceed the age of 60 in addition to reaching the Great Perfection of Qi Refining in cultivation.
Once a monk is over 60 years old, due to the decline of his body's Qi and blood, the possibility of successful foundation building is almost zero.
The great elder Liu Qiusheng said at this time: "Currently, among the monks in the family, those under the age of 60, the ones with the highest cultivation level are Shisheng and Shihao. Let's see if this works. Whoever among these two is the first to reach the perfection of Qi Refining, the family will support him in building the foundation first."
After hearing Liu Qiusheng's suggestion, all the elders agreed.
Especially the fathers Liu Shihao and Liu Shisheng, both of them were competing in their hearts.
Patriarch Liu Baishan continued: "It's still some time before the two of them reach the perfection of Qi refining. Therefore, in addition to accelerating the training of family foundation-building monks, everyone is talking about what other good ways can improve the family's strength in the short term?"
Liu Baichuan said: "Seeing Changxu's battle today gave me some inspiration. I feel that the family monks lacked cooperation in fighting the enemy. In the future, the cooperation of the family monks in combat effectiveness should be strengthened."
The patriarch Liu Baishan was very happy when he heard Liu Baichuan praising his grandson, and said with a smile: "I think Baichuan's opinion is very good. The reason why the wolf pack's combat effectiveness is strong is because the wolf pack has a clear division of labor and proper cooperation in battle. We must also learn from the wolf pack, and at least have some basic cooperation. Baichuan will be responsible for this matter!"
Liu Baishan continued: "Our family's organizational structure and the division of labor among the elders also need to be improved. Let's discuss it!"
Regarding this topic that involves vital interests, the speeches of the elders became much more active. The elders kept talking to each other for a long time before finally discussing the structure of the organization and the division of labor among the elders.
The meeting made the following resolutions:
The family patriarch is responsible for managing the daily affairs of the family. The patriarch is elected by the family elders council.
Family elders are members of the family elders council. The family elders' council is the highest deliberative body of the family.
The family monks have entered the late stage of Qi refining and have not seriously violated clan rules, and have been confirmed by the clan leader and the Council of Elders, that is,Can become a family elder.
There are now eight elders in the family, namely:
The Great Elder Liu Qiusheng, born in the 16th generation of the Qiu family, has attained the Great Perfection of Qi Refining.
The second elder, Liu Qiushui, is seventeenth in the Qiu generation and has attained the Great Perfection of Qi Refining.
The Third Elder Liu Baihe, the second eldest son of the Hundred-Character Generation, has attained the Great Perfection of Qi Refining.
The fourth elder, Liu Baichuan, is the seventh of the hundred-character generation and has a ninth-level cultivation.
Liu Baiqiang, the fifth elder, is the twelfth elder of the Hundred-Character Generation, with a ninth-level Qi-refining cultivation level.
Liu Shisheng, the Sixth Elder, is the fourth eldest son of the generation and has reached the eighth level of Qi refining.
The seventh elder, Liu Shihao, is the fifth in his generation and has attained the ninth level of Qi refining.
The eighth elder, Lin Yulian, has reached the seventh level of Qi refining.
The management of specific family affairs is handled by eight Tangkou:
The first is the General Affairs Hall, which is responsible for issuing family tasks, recording meritorious deeds, and managing the family treasury. The leader of the hall is the great elder Liu Qiusheng.
The second is the Mission Hall, which is responsible for the training of the family's children and the management of the Mission Hall and the Sutra Collection Pavilion. The leader of the hall is Liu Qiushui, the second elder.
The third is the Clan Soldier Hall, which is responsible for organizing clan soldiers to fight externally and managing the family's demon hunting team. The leader of the hall is Liu Baichuan, the fourth elder.
The fourth is the Spiritual Planting Hall, which is responsible for organizing family spiritual planters to plant spiritual medicines, spiritual fruits, spiritual rice, spiritual trees, etc. Manage the family's spiritual fruit orchard, spiritual medicine garden, and spiritual field. The leader of the hall is Liu Shihao, the seventh elder.
The fifth is the alchemy hall, which is responsible for the training and assessment of family alchemists. Organize a family alchemist to refine elixirs for the family. The leader of the hall is Liu Baihe, the third elder.
The sixth is the Fu Zhen Hall, which is responsible for the training and assessment of family Fu Lu masters and formation masters. Responsible for organizing family talisman masters and formation masters to make talismans and formations for the family. The leader of the hall is Liu Baiqiang, the fifth elder.
The seventh is the Weapon Refining Hall, which is responsible for the training and assessment of family weapon refining masters. Organize family weapon refiners to refine magic weapons for the family. The leader of the hall is Liu Shisheng, the sixth elder.
The eighth is the Commerce Hall, which is responsible for the family's foreign trade and the management and operation of the family's caravan and overseas stores. The leader of the hall is Lin Yulian, the eighth elder.
(End of chapter)
